title: selfcheck's leftovers counts know only the verdicts remove and keep, so a tidy row with the verdict ask is missing from their total
goal: bl_selfcheck.leftovers counts the rows with the verdict ask beside remove and keep, so the leftovers line's total includes them, and kbmon's cleanup panel (mon_clean.py) shows how many rows wait for the operator's tidy --decide answer

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import bl_selfcheck as s, bl_clean as c; cls = c.TIDY_CLASSES[0]; c.take_snapshot = lambda bl: {"planned": set(), "free_gb": 1}; c.coord_state = lambda: {}; c.candidates = lambda sn, st: {k: ([{"path": "/planted"}] if k == cls else []) for k in c.TIDY_CLASSES}; c.safe_to_remove = lambda cand, sn, st: (c.ASK, "planted"); c.row_of = lambda cand, v, r: {"class": cls, "verdict": v, "reason": r, "path": "/planted"}; c.free_gib = lambda sn, root: 100.0; c.public = lambda r: r; f = s.leftovers(type("B", (), {"root": "."})()); n = sum(sum(v.values()) for v in f["counts"].values()); print("leftovers total", n, "for one ask row"); sys.exit(0 if n == 1 else 1)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import mon_clean as m; d = {"counts": {"worktree": {"remove": 0, "keep": 0, "ask": 2}}, "rows": [{"class": "worktree", "verdict": "ask", "reason": "planted", "path": "/planted"}], "removable": 0, "bytes": 0, "free_gib": 50.0, "limit_gib": 10.0, "pressure": False}; head = m.lines(d)[:2]; print(head); sys.exit(0 if any("ask" in h for h in head) else 1)

notes: SP-ep7cyuob review (S3) widens this: bl_selfcheck.leftovers never applies bl_clean.answer_of, so an answered row still shows as ask in kbmon's cleanup panel and check_leftovers (which the cleanup session's prompt has Haiku read), and tidy --report (class_counts) counts ask rows as kept. ST-m5u7gmdo research evidence (2026-10-20, origin/main): a planted candidate whose safe_to_remove gives ask, with a recorded tidy-answer of remove, comes out of bl_clean.plan (_tools/bl_clean.py:713-715, answer_of) as remove and out of bl_selfcheck.leftovers (_tools/bl_selfcheck.py:400-417, which never calls answer_of) as ask with counts worktree {remove: 0, keep: 0} for the one listed row. kb/_self/monitoring.md:244 says the panel's verdict is remove or keep and :249 says it is tidy's verdict; kb/_self/tools.md:91 lists ask as a verdict of tidy.
